create_grid_search: create a GridSearchCV instance to exhaustively search over specified parameter values for an estimator
create_randomized_search: create a RandomizedSearchCV instance to sample parameter settings from distributions for hyperparameter optimization
build_parameter_grid: build a ParameterGrid from a dictionary mapping estimator parameters to sequences of allowed values
build_parameter_sampler: build a ParameterSampler to generate random parameter combinations from scipy distributions
run_grid_search_cv: run GridSearchCV.fit to find the best hyperparameters using cross-validation on training data
